# Upgrade R 

## In an existing renv project

1. Back up your project and renv.lock.
2. Install R using the installer appropriate for your operating system and processor.
3. Restart VS Code and verify both commands:
   R --version
   Rscript --version
4. Open R from the project directory. Keep the existing renv setup.
5. Restore the recorded packages with renv::restore(). If older packages fail to build, investigate the error before updating dependencies.
6. Run the project’s scripts and inspect the outputs.
7. Record the validated environment:
   renv::snapshot()
   renv::status()
8. Commit the updated lockfile.
9. 
Include a brief troubleshooting note based on your Matrix error, with the binary-package approach clearly labelled as updating the project’s dependencies, since it changes the recorded package versions.
The central checkpoint should be: “The upgrade is complete when the analysis runs, the outputs have been checked, and renv::status() reports no issues.”
